name: Expert_ABE_BE_Stoch
summary: This EA uses a Stochastic oscillator combined with a Moving Average filter (CBE_BE_Stoch signal) to generate buy and sell signals within the MQL5 Standard Library expert framework. It trades with fixed lot sizing and no trailing stop, relying on the signal module's threshold-based open/close logic for entry and exit decisions.
summary_zh: 该EA使用随机指标结合移动平均线过滤器(CBE_BE_Stoch信号)在MQL5标准库专家框架内生成买卖信号。采用固定手数交易且无移动止损，依赖信号模块的阈值开平仓逻辑进行入场和出场决策。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于随机指标(Stochastic)与移动平均线(MA)的组合信号进行均值回归交易。入场条件由CBE_BE_Stoch信号过滤器决定，当信号强度超过开仓阈值(默认40)时入场，低于平仓阈值(默认20)时出场。随机指标参数为K周期47、D周期9、慢速周期13，结合5周期移动平均线进行过滤，属于超买超卖反转类策略。仓位管理采用固定手数模式(CMoneyFixedLot)，默认0.1手，不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理方面仅设置了百分比参数(10%)和固定手数，缺乏动态风险控制机制。出场条件完全依赖信号阈值，没有设置止损和止盈(均为0)，也没有追踪止损，风险控制较弱。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on a mean reversion approach using a combination of Stochastic oscillator and Moving Average filter (CBE_BE_Stoch signal). Entry conditions are determined by the CBE_BE_Stoch signal filter, entering when signal strength exceeds the open threshold (default 40) and exiting when it falls below the close threshold (default 20). The Stochastic parameters are K period 47, D period 9, and slowing period 13, combined with a 5-period Moving Average for filtering, characteristic of an overbought/oversold reversal strategy. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (CMoneyFixedLot) with a default of 0.1 lots, without dynamic adjustment based on account balance. Money management only sets a percentage parameter (10%) and fixed lots, lacking dynamic risk control mechanisms. Exit conditions rely entirely on signal thresholds with no stop loss or take profit set (both 0), and no trailing stop, resulting in weak risk control.

parameters.name: Signal__StochApplied
parameters.description: 随机指标价格应用方式

pros: 使用MQL5标准库架构，代码结构清晰规范，易于维护和扩展
随机指标与移动平均线组合过滤，减少虚假信号
信号阈值可调，灵活控制开平仓条件
固定手数模式简化了仓位管理，适合初学者使用
pros_en: Uses MQL5 Standard Library architecture with clean, well-structured code that is easy to maintain and extend
Stochastic combined with Moving Average filter reduces false signals
Adjustable signal thresholds provide flexible control over entry and exit conditions
Fixed lot sizing simplifies position management, suitable for beginners
cons: 止损和止盈均为0，缺乏基本的风险保护机制
无追踪止损，盈利头寸可能大幅回撤
固定手数不随账户规模调整，无法实现动态风险管理
完全依赖信号阈值平仓，市场剧烈波动时可能无法及时退出
缺少点差过滤和滑点保护，在不利条件下可能产生亏损交易
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit are both 0, lacking basic risk protection
No trailing stop means profitable positions may experience significant drawdowns
Fixed lot size does not adjust with account size, preventing dynamic risk management
Relies entirely on signal thresholds for exit, may not exit timely during sharp market moves
Missing spread filter and slippage protection, may produce losing trades under adverse conditions
improvements: 增加止损和止盈参数，提供基本的风险保护
引入动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和波动率调整手数
添加点差过滤和滑点保护机制
增加多时间框架确认以减少虚假信号
improvements_en: Add stop loss and take profit parameters for basic risk protection
Introduce dynamic position sizing based on account balance and volatility
Add spread filter and slippage protection mechanisms
Add multi-timeframe confirmation to reduce false signals

risk_points: 止损和止盈均为0，持仓风险完全不可控
无追踪止损保护已获利润
缺少新K线检查(EveryTick=false但仍无额外保护)，可能重复开仓
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit both 0, position risk is completely uncontrolled
No trailing stop to protect accumulated profits
Lacks new bar check despite EveryTick=false, may open repeated positions
